env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Every position of a channel operation in a segment lambda of a group
# stage waits in a select with the group context, natively and in the
# ejected module. chain_stage_positions.lgo prints one ok line per position,
# for the value and for the cancelled stage.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_positions.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_positions.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_positions.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds and runs with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_positions.out
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstagepositions

go 1.27
